baseline_models.focus_anchor: The alternatives Allah/al-Rahman, the three د ع و occurrences, and singular فَلَهُ gather plural names onto one addressee.
baseline_models.mechanism: Calling bends speech toward an addressee; Allah is directly addressable, al-Rahman names mercy, and the beautiful designations disclose facets without multiplying their owner.

activation_trace.role: Calling and inclination by speech make all three invocations movements toward an addressee.
The divine name is itself available in direct address.
Mercy and tenderness supply al-Rahman with a relational quality rather than a second destination.
Naming supplies designation and indication, allowing many names to articulate one referent.
Goodness against ugliness qualifies the whole name-set and rules out merely rival labels.

changed_reading.before: The ayah permits either of two interchangeable labels and then gives a prayer-volume rule.
changed_reading.after: The alternatives stage plurality at the level of address while فَلَهُ gathers every beautiful designation onto one addressee.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two vocal prohibitions are followed by the positive command to seek a way in the state between them.
baseline_models.mechanism: Raised announcement and lowered secrecy are bounded endpoints; prayer remains articulated while seeking a traversable intermediate condition rather than merely averaging two volumes.

activation_trace.role: Public disclosure and raised sound supply the overexposed vocal endpoint.
Prayer as invocation, praise, and mercy identifies what the vocal calibration must carry.
Secreted and lowered utterance supplies the under-audible endpoint.
Active seeking makes the middle an achieved practice, not an automatic compromise.
A state intermediate between two extremes gives the sought calibration its topology.
A traversable extended road turns calibration into a repeatable mode of prayer.

changed_reading.before: The closing instruction is a static etiquette of moderate loudness.
changed_reading.after: It is a deliberately sought, repeatable vocal path that preserves articulated prayer between exposure and near-erasure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The window first places gentle guidance beside blocked speech and absent hearing; the focus middle way can therefore preserve a speaking-hearing relation rather than only regulate the speaker.

activation_trace.role: The focus asks for a road that can actually be traversed.
Sound stilled into cessation marks the lower-edge risk inside the focus prohibition.
Gentle direction toward road and truth makes seeking a way guided navigation rather than arithmetic averaging.
Imprisoned speech supplies a zero-output communicative failure.
Lost hearing and non-attention supply failed reception at the other side of communication.

structural_cues: 17:97 coordinates guidance with paired loss of speech and hearing; 17:110 answers with a sought path between two vocal negations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies guidance, blocked speech, and absent hearing; I infer that the middle path protects a speaking-hearing relation. A live alternative is that 17:97's disabilities are eschatological and do not specify prayer technique.

changed_reading.before: The midpoint protects the worshipper from two personal excesses of volume.
changed_reading.after: The guided vocal path protects the relation itself: speech must neither become display nor disappear before it can be received.

context_deltas.mechanism: The treasury scene opposes abundant mercy to human holding and constriction; al-Rahman in the focus thus becomes an anti-scarcity mode of address, not merely an alternate label.

activation_trace.role: Mercy and tender beneficence are concentrated in the invoked name al-Rahman.
Calling opens verbal approach to the named source rather than possessing it.
Preserved treasure supplies the image of mercy held in inexhaustible reserve.
The same mercy branch directly primes the later name al-Rahman.
Withholding wealth from stinginess supplies the human closure opposed by the merciful address.
Expenditure supplies the feared outward flow that humans try to stop.
Constriction and reduction name the scarcity posture from which al-Rahman releases the reading.

structural_cues: 17:100's خزائن رحمة supplies a direct lexical and possessive precursor to الرحمن and فله in 17:110.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies treasuries of mercy and a human impulse to withhold their outflow; I infer that calling al-Rahman opposes possession by scarcity. The live alternative is that the economic scene only illustrates human character and adds no invocation mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Al-Rahman is one permissible synonym in a naming question.
changed_reading.after: Calling al-Rahman addresses mercy as non-hoarded abundance: the names belong to the giver and are approached by invocation, not depleted by use.

context_deltas.mechanism: Visible signs, clarification, and inward insight activate the focus inventory's mark-making branch: beautiful names function as readable indicators through which the one addressee becomes recognizably present.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark turns the name-set into recognitional evidence.
Goodness qualifies the marks by the kind of reality they disclose.
An outwardly apparent sign supplies the window's explicit model of recognition.
Meaning disclosed by speech or sign makes clarity an interpretive operation.
Insight of the heart supplies the receptive capacity by which the indicators become intelligible.

structural_cues: 17:101-102 move from plural clear signs to بصائر; 17:110 later presents plural beautiful names and an open choice of address.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mark, manifest sign, clarification, and inward insight; I infer that the names mediate recognition rather than merely catalog vocabulary. A live alternative is that the signs concern Moses alone and do not alter divine naming.

changed_reading.before: The beautiful names are a list of acceptable appellations.
changed_reading.after: They are beautiful identifying signs: diverse verbal marks that disclose one referent to attentive recognition.

context_deltas.mechanism: Partitioned recitation with deliberation, followed sound, tears, and humility expands the focus middle way from decibel control into acoustic-temporal delivery calibrated for embodied uptake.

activation_trace.role: Raised public sound remains one prohibited acoustic boundary.
Lowered secret utterance remains the other acoustic boundary.
The intermediate state can host more than a single fixed loudness.
A traversable way permits a sustained delivery practice.
Reading and recitation supply the concrete vocal process to be calibrated.
Distribution into parts supplies articulated spacing rather than an undifferentiated vocal mass.
Deliberation without haste supplies temporal pacing.
One sound following another supplies audible sequence and continuity.
Tears and voice show recitation reaching an embodied affective response.
Lowering and submission identify receptive transformation as the delivery's effect.

structural_cues: 17:106 specifies recitation to people على مكث; 17:107-109 then sequence recitation, bodily lowering, tears, and increased humility immediately before 17:110.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies partition, unhurried recitation, sound following sound, and embodied response; I infer that the sought middle way includes cadence and receptivity as well as volume. The live alternative confines 17:110 to loudness alone.

changed_reading.before: Seek a medium volume for prayer.
changed_reading.after: Seek a paced audible practice in which differentiated sounds can reach hearers and ripen into humility without becoming spectacle or vanishing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah removes derivation, partnership, and divided sovereignty before commanding magnification; this closes off reading Allah/al-Rahman as separate holders behind the plurality of names.

activation_trace.role: Allah supplies one directly invoked divine name.
Al-Rahman supplies a second address formed from merciful relation.
Plural designation is explicitly owned by the singular pronoun in the focus.
Denial of anything derived or produced from another blocks genealogical partition of deity.
Denied partnership blocks allocating the names to co-owners.
Sovereignty supplies the undivided domain in which partnership is denied.
Greatness and majesty turn the response to plurality into magnification of the one owner.

structural_cues: 17:111 immediately follows the focus with three coordinated negations and an intensive closing command to magnify.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit denials of derivation and partnership in sovereignty after the naming alternatives; I infer that the sequel regulates how their plurality is understood. A live alternative treats 17:111 as an independent doxology.

changed_reading.before: The two calls converge grammatically, but the conceptual status of plural names remains open.
changed_reading.after: The names are plural without partition: no lineage, partner, or divided sovereignty stands behind the alternate addresses.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ق ل ل mapping for focus ق و ل; it remains anchored at word 1 and coheres with the two vocal limits, but downstream prose should present it only as a branch-shadow on قُل, never as its translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The opening قُل and the closing prohibition of both raised and extinguished speech frame the whole ayah as an enacted utterance.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant littleness branch places an exploratory economy-of-speech shadow behind the command to say.
Raised public sound marks verbal excess against which littleness can be heard.
Cessation of sound prevents economy from collapsing into no speech.

changed_reading.before: قُل simply introduces a proposition about names and volume.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory branch-shadow, the command itself models economical speech: less than display, more than disappearance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the dairy image inside د ع و; the three exact repetitions and their containment within named prayer keep it anchored, but downstream prose should mark it as a material analogy for sustained invocation, not a lexical claim about الدعاء.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: د ع و occurs three times around two names before the ayah turns to maintaining prayer between acoustic extremes.

activation_trace.role: Milk intentionally retained to draw what follows makes each repeated call an exploratory starter for the next movement of invocation.
The plurality of designations provides successive verbal channels through which calling can continue.
Prayer as invocation and praise contains the flow image within an actual devotional process.

changed_reading.before: The repeated دعوا merely restates the permissibility of either name.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, each named call primes further calling, while the middle vocal path keeps the devotional flow from being forced or cut off.

strongest_changes: 17:100 turns al-Rahman from an alternate label into an anti-withholding address to non-hoarded mercy.
17:106-109 expand the middle way from volume to paced, differentiated recitation ordered toward embodied reception.
17:111 makes plural names explicitly non-partitive by denying derivation, partnership, and divided sovereignty.
summary.what_was_special: The focus joins two plurality problems that usually separate: many names converge on one addressee, while many audible syllables must travel one calibrated path. The window sharpens both convergence and delivery.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether 17:97's speech/hearing collapse legitimately informs prayer audibility or only supplies a distant contrast.
Whether the sign/mark mapping makes names epistemic indicators or merely enriches the ordinary idea of designation.
Whether temporal pacing belongs inside سبيلًا بين acoustic extremes or remains a neighboring recitation instruction.
The ق ل ل and dairy activations are intentionally retained only as exploratory branch-shadows.
